title: The framed stream, recorded byte for byte
about: The body of GET /v1/aokie-companion/relay/stream as the relay writes it (status 200, Content-Type text/event-stream; charset=utf-8, Cache-Control no-store, X-Accel-Buffering no). Feed each body to the carriers' SseParser, whole and split at every offset.

cases.name: the plugin's stream with three frames waiting
cases.note: The preamble, one frame event per frame with id = seq, and end with the cursor. The stream lasts min(20, wait.max) seconds; this recording is cut at 0.6.
